editorial_review_row.content: ACY Securities scores 6.0/10 from NAFT in 2026. An ASIC-regulated Australian broker with ProZero raw spreads from 0.0 pips ($6 RT), execution within 30ms from 16 liquidity providers, and 2,200+ CFDs. The catch — international clients are routed to a St Vincent and Grenadines entity with minimal oversight, four national regulators have flagged ACY for operating without local authorisation, and withdrawal delay complaints appear across public forums. Legit under ASIC for Australian residents, but the offshore entity carries real risk for everyone else.
